text: Warmup. Get your sea legs, shipmate. Five easy minutes before the Goat Locker decides this needs to be a training opportunity.
E-4 Mafia pace: move with purpose, look busy, and don't get voluntold for some bullshit working party.
Recover. Skate smart, breathe deep, and stay invisible enough that nobody hands you a paint brush.
Back on it. Eight minutes. Embrace the suck. If Chief asks, you've been moving like this the whole damn time.
Three-minute recovery. Hydrate, unfuck your breathing, and enjoy the closest thing to liberty you're getting right now.
Last hard five. Deckplate rules: head down, feet moving, and save the bitching until the evolution is secured.
Cooldown. Stand down, shipmate. You survived without a field day, a counseling chit, or extra tasking from the Goat Locker. That's a win.
